cases.title: An older snapshot never removes a kill
cases.when: A component holding kill K receives a push or page that predates K
then: K stays effective
The component logs the stale delivery

cases.title: Replayed and reordered pushes can only add kills
cases.when: Pushes K1, R1 (supersedes K1), K2 are delivered as K2, K1, R1, K1, K2
then: Final effective set is {K2}
No ordering of the same events yields a different set

cases.title: TERMINATE beats STOP_NEW for overlapping scopes
cases.when: A STOP_NEW kill on a package and a TERMINATE kill on its publisher are both effective
then: The package's running work is terminated

cases.title: Each scope kind matches what it names
cases.when: One kill per scope kind PACKAGE, PACKAGE_DIGEST, PUBLISHER, TOOL, POOL, RUNTIME_IMAGE and TENANT is evaluated against a matrix of invocations
then: Each kill matches exactly the invocations in the expected table
A TENANT kill has no scope value

cases.title: A full fetch older than the highest epoch seen is refused
cases.when: A host that has seen epoch 42 receives a correctly signed full page at epoch 41
then: The page is refused and the current set kept
A page at epoch 42 or later replaces the set

cases.title: Kill signatures do not cross-verify with other fleet documents
cases.when: A fleet-signed policy bundle is presented as a kill event, and a kill event as a kill push
then: Both are rejected on typ

cases.title: A kill commits with an epoch bump and stops new work at once
cases.when: A kill commits while a reserve for the killed package is in flight
then: The reserve fails the epoch check
Matching stored work is cancelled in the same commit

cases.title: Break-glass needs two distinct operator keys
cases.when: Break-glass requests with one approval, two approvals from the same key, and two from distinct keys
then: Only the last succeeds
The kill has issuer control-breakglass and is audited

cases.title: Operator approvals are single-use and short-lived
cases.when: A valid approval set is replayed, and another is presented after notAfterUnixMs or with a window over 10 minutes
then: All three are refused

cases.title: Break-glass cannot issue recoveries
cases.when: A break-glass request asks for a RECOVERY
then: Schema validation fails
A direct insert of a control-breakglass RECOVERY fails the database check

cases.title: Break-glass needs the operator listener and no admin token
cases.when: POST break-glass/kills is sent to the public listener with an admin token, and to the operator listener without one
then: Public listener: not found
Operator listener with valid approvals: accepted

cases.title: A recovery needs two reviewers who are not the requester
cases.when: A recovery is approved by the requester, by one reviewer, and by two distinct reviewers
then: Only the last applies
Cancelled work stays cancelled after recovery
